title: Warm without a furnace
hook: Body temperature can change with surroundings.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The arrows show heat moving from a stipulated warmer rock toward the lizard. Ectothermy describes dependence on external heat sources, not a fixed low body temperature; actual temperature varies with conditions and behavior.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: An ectothermic lizard rests on a warm rock. Must its body always be cold?

claims.text: Body temperature can change with surroundings. An ectothermic lizard rests on a warm rock. Must its body always be cold?
